payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_session.py::test_no_inert_pattern_or_unbuilt_tree_refuses_an_edit_and_a_broken_read_orphans stayed green with the criterion's own edit applied to saffron/phases/review.py. The claim was "A repo that declares no inert pattern refuses no edit as inert. No `files_after` read is made, and every pair reaches the mutator as at base. When patterns are declared and `files_after` returns an empty dict, no edit is refused as inert either, and each pair reaches the mutator as at base. Under declared patterns, a `GitError` from `files_after` reaches the caller of `run_one_cell` unchanged, before any edit is applied. `_drive_cell`'s `except BaseException` then marks the ledger's run row `ABORTED` and the task `ORPHANED`. The witness drives three cells through REVIEW, each with one inert-shaped criterion probe and one inert-shaped wrong version. Under declared patterns with the read stubbed to return an empty dict, both edits reach the mutator, and the version is `killed` with no `refusal` key. Under no declared pattern with the read stubbed to raise a `GitError`, the same holds and the drive returns. Under declared patterns with that raising read, the drive raises it. No edit reaches the mutator, and the reopened ledger holds those two states.". Under the edit the whole `tests` gate failed tests/test_session.py::test_a_killed_or_errored_criterion_probe_files_nothing_and_stops_nothing, tests/test_session.py::test_every_probe_a_session_names_is_applied_under_its_own_criterion_and_each_survivor_blocks, tests/test_session.py::test_a_wrong_version_its_witness_survives_is_rebutted_as_a_blocker, tests/test_session.py::test_an_edit_that_removes_nothing_is_refused_before_any_witness_reads_it, tests/test_session.py::test_a_survivor_whose_whole_suite_cannot_answer_keeps_todays_blocker, tests/test_session.py::test_a_probe_cell_that_stops_is_entered_once_more_for_every_pair_left, tests/test_session.py::test_a_second_stop_files_every_pair_left_as_an_error_naming_the_runtime_error, tests/test_session.py::test_every_wrong_version_is_recorded_with_its_outcome_beside_the_criterion_probes, and the criterion's witness did not fail.
